_purpose: Hand-maintained registry of which instrument/sample belongs to which env-audio entity in the RPG world (birds, water, and eventually NPCs). Requested by Han (2026-08-17, ticket #925/#993): 'Maak eventueel een json die je bijwerkt om dit soort info up to date te houden (welk instrument, horend bij welke entiteit, etc)'. Update this file whenever an env-audio instrument/source choice changes -- it is the source of truth for what's implemented vs. still a placeholder/blocked, read by humans and agents, not imported by app code.

bird.notes: One independent panned voice per currently-audible bird critter (world-distance chunk model). Han's Reaper project (src/assets/ASSET DROP/bird sounds.rpp, 2026-08-17) names each bird track with its intended instrument in parens: pigeon/cuckoo/sparrow hi/sparrow low/owl all '(piccolo)', duck '(bassoon)' -- ALL of them currently still play uniformly on shakuhachi (the original #924 choice). piccolo and bassoon are now locally extracted (src/constants/instruments.jsx, scripts/extract-soundfont-samples.mjs) and available to switch to, but the bird_sounds.mid actually loaded at runtime still only has the original 5 unison-shakuhachi tracks -- switching per-species instruments needs a re-export of bird sounds.mid (like the water one) AND a generate-bird-sounds.mjs change to route by track name (currently plays any track uniformly, see script header). Not yet done -- ask Han before touching, per CLAUDE.md #9k (avoid guessing on musical/UX decisions).

water_hum.source: src/songs/world_midis/water sounds.mid (track 'water hum (viola - hold ad infinitum)')
water_hum.notes: One continuous held note (no natural release, relies on the viola sample's own real loop points), panned/faded by the chunk model. Pitch/velocity read straight from the generated manifest (scripts/generate-water-sounds.mjs -> src/model/waterSoundsManifest.generated.js) instead of a hand-picked placeholder -- source MIDI has exactly one 8-beat note (C2, velocity 76) meant to be held indefinitely, matching Han's original 'hele lange noot, zonder release' framing.

water_glockenspiel.notes: Plays the REAL composed 18-note phrase (~7 beats) via playMelodies() periodically while water is in audible range -- replaced the earlier placeholder (a single random note from a hand-picked pool on tubular_bells, which was never even locally extracted). glockenspiel is now locally extracted (GM program 10).

water_percussion.source: GM Sound Effects program 126 ('Applause'), locally extracted (scripts/extract-soundfont-samples.mjs) -- held indefinitely at C4, same 'no natural release' mechanism as water_hum. The real MIDI drum pattern in waterSoundsManifest.generated.js's waterPercussion layer is NOT used by this -- Han (2026-08-19): 'je mag de midi negeren'.
water_percussion.notes: Interim substitute for real GM percussion, quieted twice on UAT (mp -> p -> pp, Han: 'a bit too loud' / 'even softer'). The REAL generated percussion (see level_hh_percussion below) was ALSO briefly a water voice (#1091 rounds 2-3) but round 4 decoupled it into its own level-wide loop -- applause remains water's own dedicated interim layer, unrelated to that now.

level_wind_gust.source: Own dedicated createMelodicInstrument('applause') instance (separate from water_percussion's own applause instance) -> a plain GainNode automated with native Web Audio ramps (setValueAtTime/linearRampToValueAtTime), NOT playMelodies/.volumes like every other voice.
level_wind_gust.status: implemented -- level-wide, random trigger only (Han 2026-08-20: 'Trigger het voorlopig random - later wil ik dat ook plaatsgebonden maken')
level_wind_gust.notes: Every 2-measure cycle independently rolls a 20% chance to start a gust; on a hit, applause plays for the full 2-measure cycle under a 0->peak(midpoint)->0 fade envelope, peak reusing water_percussion's own (very low) gain. Separate voice from water_percussion (Han: 'keep both'), not a replacement. Future work (Han's own words): tie triggering to location instead of pure randomness.

level_hh_percussion.instrument: MuldjordKit HihatClosed (29 velocity-layered samples) + FreePats Percussion's other pads
level_hh_percussion.source: generateHh (generateBackbeat.js) -- hi-hat every subdivision, cymbal-pool substitution, played through 'FreePats Percussion' (createFreePatsPercussionInstrument, drumKits.js). hh's own samples come from MuldjordKit's HihatClosed folder (scripts/extract-muldjord-hihat.mjs), the other substitution-pool pads (ho/hp/r/cr_bell) from the original FreePats set.
level_hh_percussion.status: implemented -- level-wide (#1091 round 4, Han: 'Zorg dat percussie door het hele level te horen is, niet enkel bij water'), NOT gated to water proximity
level_hh_percussion.notes: Own top-level ambient effect in useWorldAmbientMusic.js (same 'unconditional while active' shape as the ambient piano loop, no spatial pan/bus) -- was one of water's voices in rounds 2-3, moved out entirely in round 4. Every HH_BLOCK_MEASURES(4)-measure block re-rolls smallestNoteDenom uniformly from {1,2,4,8,16} (Han confirmed keeping this uniform, not weighted) and looks up notesPerMeasure from generateHh's own HH_NOTES_PER_MEASURE_BY_DENOM table. Percussion sample playback also uses the new 'humanization' mechanism (drumKits.js humanizePercussionSample) -- a velocity-window sample pick with a compensating gain jitter, applied to every array-valued percussion pad, not hh-specific.
